headline: Trane Technologies (TT) Stock Looks Reasonable Rather Than Cheap Today
summary: Trane Technologies stock has delivered a strong 156.0% return over the past 5 years, and at around US$483.34 per share the current market price now sits close to its intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model, while the broader valuation checks suggest the shares are not an obvious bargain. Over 5 years, a 156.0% total return highlights how strongly Trane Technologies has rewarded long term shareholders, which raises the bar for any new upside from here. Expectations...
